counterexamples.title: sharp peak versus a broad profitable neighbourhood
counterexamples.expectation: the peak has the better raw quality but a large neighbour regret, so R prefers the broad profitable region
counterexamples.reproducer: two synthetic neighbourhoods with identical episode counts
counterexamples.note: all valid bad probes stay in the denominator; none is dropped for losing

counterexamples.title: a perfectly flat region that is negative
counterexamples.expectation: flatness alone must not qualify: the region fails economic quality
counterexamples.note: R is high because F is tiny, which is exactly why the quality gate is separate

counterexamples.title: duplicate samples must not inflate the local panel
counterexamples.expectation: every probe in a local panel is a distinct point
counterexamples.reproducer: request 10 probes inside a tight radius and count unique ids

counterexamples.title: a fixed dimension dilutes every distance
counterexamples.expectation: a parameter that never varies carries no information and must not enter the denominator
counterexamples.reproducer: call the installed _param_distance with and without a constant parameter in param_names
counterexamples.note: the WFO family is NOT affected: _is_clusterable_param drops any parameter that does not vary before the matrix is built

counterexamples.title: one far-away sample rescales the whole geometry
counterexamples.expectation: geometry must come from the DECLARED bounds, so an unrelated sample cannot rescale it
counterexamples.reproducer: add one distant record and re-measure the distance between two unchanged points
counterexamples.note: the WFO family normalises by the declared (low, high) in param_ranges and is immune; only the CandidateSelector family rescales

counterexamples.title: an inactive parameter manufactures distance

observed.cause: a missing value is not numeric, so the branch returns a full unit of distance

counterexamples.expectation: an inactive conditional parameter must not create distance; a branch MISMATCH is a declared, locked penalty instead
counterexamples.reproducer: compare two points that differ only in whether a conditional branch is active

counterexamples.title: no local consensus available
counterexamples.expectation: with no neighbour sharing an episode there is no stability evidence, so the candidate is INSUFFICIENT_LOCAL_EVIDENCE rather than silently excellent
counterexamples.reproducer: score a candidate whose neighbourhood is empty

counterexamples.title: a centroid nobody evaluated is not deployable
counterexamples.expectation: a geometric centre is a proposal; it must be evaluated before it can be selected
counterexamples.reproducer: compute the centroid of three evaluated candidates and try to deploy it

counterexamples.title: a raw-quality guard disagrees with the robust objective
counterexamples.expectation: when a raw guard and the robust objective disagree the policy must be VISIBLE, and the incumbent must be judged on the same objective and budget as the challenger
counterexamples.reproducer: score an incumbent on a plateau against a challenger on a peak
counterexamples.note: the incumbent received the same episode count and the same neighbourhood budget

counterexamples.title: full-sample tuned presets must not seed the primary bank
counterexamples.expectation: every supplied preset is provenance=user_full_sample_tpe and is barred from the primary candidate bank and from warm-starting an early fold
counterexamples.reproducer: read the committed preset catalog and check the eligibility flags

candidate_selection.geometry: normalised by the SAMPLED span of observed records

walkforward.geometry: normalised by the DECLARED param_ranges; non-varying parameters dropped

scoping_rule: a claim about 'the selector' would be wrong: the two families measure distance differently, so every finding names the family it applies to
